decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink sits furthest from the firm's engineering and waste-to-energy know-how, so its in-house R&D gives little help in reading market results, but the firm frames it as part of its biomass-to-nutrients offer and gave it its own page, so it is kept with a sizeable drop risk.
Modular plant extensions draw directly on the firm's core waste-to-energy engineering, automation and prototyping capabilities, so the firm can learn from deployments and refine the models.

WASTX Oil is a flagship that builds on the firm's established technology and is backed by its own R&D and university cooperation, giving it strong capacity to assimilate feedback and improve the plant.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship close to the firm's core conversion know-how, and it was promoted to its own page in 2019, which signals continued investment and learning potential.
